name: bb-plugin-office-viewer

bb.name: Office Viewer
bb.description: Excel-like spreadsheets in BB: live formulas, click-to-reference formula entry, fill, copy and paste, saving without losing formatting, quoting cells into the chat. Word, PowerPoint and PDF with search, zoom and quoting; images with zoom and an editor (arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps, blur, crop) that saves or sends to the chat; videos with speed, frame steps and frame grabs; audio with a waveform player.

description: Office Viewer for BB: view .xlsx, .xls, .ods and .csv spreadsheets, edit .xlsx/.csv in place keeping formatting, quote cells into the chat.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test locate.test.ts sheet.test.ts csv.test.ts xlsx-patch.test.ts edits.test.ts formula.test.ts engine.test.ts pptx.test.ts
